title: Get languages
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get the enum values of language codes. After you obtain the language codes, you can pass them to `languages` in [/adgroup/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739499616346114) for language targeting. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/tools/language/|/v1.3/tool/language/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`: number|`advertiser_id`: string| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tool/language/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string| Advertiser ID | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --get -H "Access-Token:xxx" \ --data-urlencode "advertiser_id=ADVERTISER_ID" \ https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tool/language/ (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Return code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message |string|Return message. For details, see [Appendix-Return codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |data |object|Returned data. | #|languages|object[]| Language list. | ##|code|string| Language code. You can pass the value of this field to `languages` in [/adgroup/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739499616346114) for language targeting.

Example: `en`.| ##|name|string| Language name.

Example: `English`.| |request_id |string|The log id of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "20220630225329010245246039165DE9B4", "data": { "languages": [ { "name": "Arabic", "code": "ar" }, { "name": "Assamese", "code": "as" }, { "name": "Haryanvi", "code": "bgc" }, { "name": "Bihari", "code": "bh" }, ... ] } } (/code); ```
